evidence_quotes: I had fresh rosemary on hand which was nice and used dried thyme and dried parsley.

benefit.description: Using dried thyme and parsley provides an option when fresh versions are not available.

evidence_quotes: I put everything into a mini food processor to blend.
I pounded the chicken down thin and let it marinate for close to 12 hours.
If you're not a fan of balsamic - use white wine or white wine vinegar.

benefit.description: A mini food processor, thin chicken breasts, a 12-hour marinade, and white wine instead of balsamic may make the marinade easier to prepare and provide an alternative flavor.

edits.replacement_text: Process white wine, oil, garlic, parsley, rosemary, thyme, sage, salt, and pepper in a mini food processor until well combined. Place chicken in a glass dish or bowl and pour marinade over top. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 12 hours.

evidence_quotes: This chicken would be great over pasta!

benefit.description: Serving the chicken over pasta may provide another appealing way to serve it.

skipped_reviews.reason: The reviewer uses dried herbs instead of fresh ones but does not specify exact replacement amounts; the recipe already instructs grilling the chicken.
